responsibility: Declares the core command-line options for the RX backend and binds them to target masks, variables, enums, and generated option metadata. It defines CPU selection, FPU and double-size controls, endianness, small-data and constant-size thresholds, PID mode, ABI selection, relaxation, interrupt-related settings, string-instruction enablement, JSR selection, and LRA control, forming the main option table consumed by GCC’s option parser and referenced throughout rx.cc and rx.h.
same_name_distinction: Declares the RX-specific command-line options and generated option variables/enums, such as CPU selection, endianness, PID, ABI, and LRA controls, which are then referenced by rx.h and rx.cc; unlike the other same-stem files, it is the option-definition input to GCC's option machinery, not backend logic or instruction patterns.
